content: Good morning, this is Officer James Miller with the IRS Fraud Division, badge number 865214. Am I speaking with Ms. Eleanor Carter?
Yes, this is Eleanor. Is something wrong? I haven't received anything from the IRS before.

I'm contacting you regarding a discrepancy in your 2021 and 2022 federal tax filings. According to our records, you may qualify for a special debt reduction program under IRS case file 10843-K. This is time-sensitive.
Debt reduction? I don't understand. I thought my taxes were all paid through my pension.

Currently, there is an outstanding balance that was not addressed, but you are eligible for immediate tax relief if you act now. This is a rare opportunity to resolve your IRS liability before further action.
Oh my, I really can't afford to owe anything. What do I need to do?
First, to initiate your enrollment in the relief program, there is a mandatory $950 legal preparation fee. This covers expedited processing and ensures your account is protected from escalation.
That's a lot of money for me. Is there any way to spread it out?

Unfortunately, because your file is flagged for urgent review, the IRS requires the full fee up front to prevent penalties. If this isn't resolved today, you could face wage garnishment or even legal proceedings.
I don't want that, but I don't know how to pay something like that all at once.

We can accept payment through a secure method to avoid any delays. The IRS now uses digital vouchers for urgent settlements. You'll need to purchase $950 worth of Target gift cards from your nearest store.
Gift cards? That seems unusual for the IRS. Are you sure?

Due to pandemic-related fraud controls, traditional payments are restricted for high-risk cases. Digital vouchers are authorized for expedited relief. This is the only way to secure your eligibility and halt enforcement action.
Alright, I suppose I can get to Target this afternoon, but I'll need some time.

Thank you for cooperating, Ms. Carter. Please stay on the line while you purchase the cards. Once you have them, I'll need you to read the codes on the back so I can process your application immediately.
Do I need to bring anything else or just buy the cards?
Just your identification in case store staff ask. Remember, do not mention the IRS or your case, as this could delay the process. Call me as soon as you have the cards so we can finalize your relief.
I'm really worried about getting in trouble. This won't affect my Social Security, will it?
As long as you complete the payment today, your Social Security and benefits will remain unaffected. Failure to comply could result in federal withholding and legal action.
Alright, I'll get ready and head out now.
Perfect. Once you have the gift cards, return to the phone and read me each code clearly so I can confirm your enrollment. This must be done before 5 PM today to avoid escalation.
Okay, I'll call you as soon as I get back. I really hope this works.
